title: Improve autonomy-next help and empty-queue guidance
summary: autonomy-next currently treats --help as an unknown flag and prints an unhelpful empty-queue message. This stalls operators when the task queue is empty or when they forget to pass --seed. Add a real usage message, validate unknown flags, and when no task is available print the exact next command(s) to run.
expectedFailureModes: Operators call autonomy-next --help and get no usage guidance.
Autonomy loops stall because the empty-queue message doesn't mention --seed.
Unknown flags silently change behavior, causing automation drift.
nextAction: Add --help/--json/--seed parsing with unknown-flag rejection, plus a clearer empty-queue message that points to autonomy-next --seed and autonomy-seed-next; keep JSON output stable.
